attributes.description:
Maximum of covariances (in absolute value) at each iteration.
``n_alphas`` is either ``max_iter``, ``n_features`` or the
number of nodes in the path with ``alpha >= alpha_min``, whichever
is smaller. If this is a list of array-like, the length of the outer
list is `n_targets`.
attributes.name: alphas_
attributes.type_doc: array-like of shape (n_alphas + 1,) or list of such arrays

attributes.description:
Indices of active variables at the end of the path.
If this is a list of list, the length of the outer list is `n_targets`.
attributes.name: active_
attributes.type_doc: list of shape (n_alphas,) or list of such lists

attributes.description:
The varying values of the coefficients along the path. It is not
present if the ``fit_path`` parameter is ``False``. If this is a list
of array-like, the length of the outer list is `n_targets`.
attributes.name: coef_path_
attributes.type_doc: array-like of shape (n_features, n_alphas + 1) or list of such arrays

attributes.description: Parameter vector (w in the formulation formula).
attributes.name: coef_

attributes.description:
The number of iterations taken by lars_path to find the
grid of alphas for each target.
attributes.name: n_iter_

attributes.description:
Number of features seen during :term:`fit`.

.. versionadded:: 0.24
attributes.name: n_features_in_

attributes.description:
Names of features seen during :term:`fit`. Defined only when `X`
has feature names that are all strings.

.. versionadded:: 1.0
attributes.name: feature_names_in_

parameters.description:
Whether to calculate the intercept for this model. If set
to false, no intercept will be used in calculations
(i.e. data is expected to be centered).
parameters.name: fit_intercept

parameters.description:
Whether to use a precomputed Gram matrix to speed up
calculations. If set to ``'auto'`` let us decide. The Gram
matrix can also be passed as argument.
parameters.name: precompute

parameters.description: Target number of non-zero coefficients. Use ``np.inf`` for no limit.
parameters.name: n_nonzero_coefs

parameters.description:
The machine-precision regularization in the computation of the
Cholesky diagonal factors. Increase this for very ill-conditioned
systems. Unlike the ``tol`` parameter in some iterative
optimization-based algorithms, this parameter does not control
the tolerance of the optimization.
parameters.name: eps

parameters.description: If ``True``, X will be copied; else, it may be overwritten.
parameters.name: copy_X

parameters.description:
If True the full path is stored in the ``coef_path_`` attribute.
If you compute the solution for a large problem or many targets,
setting ``fit_path`` to ``False`` will lead to a speedup, especially
with a small alpha.
parameters.name: fit_path

parameters.description:
Upper bound on a uniform noise parameter to be added to the
`y` values, to satisfy the model's assumption of
one-at-a-time computations. Might help with stability.

.. versionadded:: 0.23

parameters.description:

for reproducible output across multiple function calls.
See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`. Ignored if `jitter` is None.
